modules.name: ThisWorkbook
modules.summary: Handles changes on the Expenses sheet to assign IDs and timestamps, and clear related data when a row becomes empty.

modules.name: modExpenseTracker
modules.summary: Manages expense entry, reporting, and export functions.

procedures.name: Workbook_SheetChange
procedures.summary: Responds to changes on the Expenses sheet, assigning a new ID and timestamps or clearing row data when the row is empty.
procedures.support_reason: Worksheet_Change event cascade (found by the rule check).

procedures.name: AddExpense
procedures.summary: Validates entry form and appends a new expense record to the Expenses sheet.
procedures.support_reason: All constructs map directly to .NET equivalents.

procedures.name: ClearForm
procedures.summary: Resets the entry form and clears the status message.
procedures.support_reason: All constructs are straightforward sheet operations.

procedures.name: ResetForm
procedures.summary: Clears entry fields and sets the date field to today.

procedures.name: ShowStatus
procedures.summary: Displays a status message on the entry sheet, coloring it based on error flag.

procedures.name: GenerateReport
procedures.summary: Creates a new Report sheet with summary figures, category breakdown, and the five largest expenses.
procedures.support_reason: All used Excel object model features are covered by migration support.

procedures.name: ExportReportPDF
procedures.summary: Generates the report and exports it as a PDF file.
procedures.support_reason: Excel PDF export through COM (found by the rule check).

procedures.name: ExportExpensesCSV
procedures.summary: Exports all expense rows to a CSV file.
procedures.support_reason: Uses VBA file I/O (Open, Print, Close) which requires custom handling.

procedures.name: ExportFolder
procedures.summary: Returns the folder path to use for exported files, falling back to the default path if needed.
procedures.support_reason: Path handling uses standard properties that map to .NET equivalents.
